report:
Reviewed the full candidate_completeness claim, all six ordinary implementation entries, and the sole associated TODO test. The contract covers the local compilation plus reachable dependency metadata, fixed-trait discovery, conservative self-head filtering retaining blanket/unclassifiable candidates, and explicit incompleteness preventing exhaustive No. Captured solver-guide and architectural-foundations sections distinguish this semantic discovery boundary from the separate planned local incremental index.

clauses.rs assemble_candidates gathers matching environment facts and starts incomplete when assumptions are incomplete. Unknown self shape, missing trait signature, or unsupported trait eligibility retain uncertainty. Ordinary traits consult the local trait-keyed source and, for external traits, the external trait/self-head source. Missing/ineligible impl headers make the result incomplete instead of disappearing as negative evidence. Sized/MetaSized use explicit structural semantics; ordinary operator traits have no synthetic operator candidate here. The orphan shortcut applies only to a foreign trait with no trait arguments and known non-fundamental foreign nominal self; missing fundamental metadata does not enable pruning. Local traits require no upstream explicit impl discovery because upstream crates cannot name that local trait.

local_syms/impls.rs local_impl_candidates is a tracked fixed-trait API, currently scanning local expanded modules recursively internally. It retains matching impl identities, excludes known unrelated traits and inherent impls, and marks unresolved trait paths, malformed matching signatures, active attributes, and expansion hazards incomplete. Captured module completeness helpers conservatively handle unexpanded/failed/depth-limited item macros and unsupported derives. Unsupported builtin derives are complete for a different known hygienic trait only; absent/ambiguous derive identity remains incomplete. This review does not claim the separate destination private bucket index is already implemented.

external_syms.rs external_relevant_impls preserves raw completeness, returns empty incomplete on missing provider data, and rejects wrongly tagged identities while setting incomplete. Its simplifier keeps aliases/parameters/unknown shapes unrefined, separates external ADT identity, and uses conservative coarse scalar/tuple/reference categories. The rustc bridge relevant_trait_impls entry calls all_impls for the fixed trait, excludes rustc-local identities (Sage separately owns local source), optionally rejects only a positively classified different rigid self head, and sorts/deduplicates external identities. Its companion head classifier returns None for blanket parameters, aliases and unclassified forms, so these fallback candidates survive. Completeness is withheld for auto traits and unmodeled lang-item candidate sources; explicit operator impls and rigid-ADT Iterator exclusions are handled separately, with Sized/MetaSized routed through structural candidates. The captured TcxDb declaration specifies this same provider contract; source inspection is not an independent differential proof of rustc metadata exhaustiveness.

prove.rs solve_trait_frame carries the assembled completeness bit through isolated candidate evaluation to merge_candidate_results. merge.rs permits No only when no Yes/Maybe survives and the source was complete. Incomplete enumeration reaches merge_hints with an additional unconstrained possibility, so absent work cannot produce hard negative evidence or fabricated substitution facts. The unconditional empty-substitution true Proven absorption is a valid independent proof, not an exhaustive negative conclusion; it does not fabricate a value output.

The sole associated test solver_candidate_completeness is explicitly TODO and has no executable assertions. Its comment covers local/upstream/blanket/unsimplifiable fixtures, excluding unrelated traits/disjoint heads, indexed-versus-exhaustive canonical response equivalence, incomplete-source negative prevention, and primitive operator metadata provenance. All are retained as verification debt. Prerequisites are source fixtures with reachable dependency metadata plus an exhaustive comparison observation path and query/provenance assertions for primitive core impls. Current code inspection supports the implementation shape but does not discharge any of those runtime comparisons. No ordinary test association was inferred from nearby tests. No source edits or tests were executed for this review; review start/read and source inspection were the commands used before record. No additional requested edits; the existing TODO honestly preserves missing verification.
